conversation.Statement: Hello, may I speak with Mrs. Evelyn Harper? This is Lisa from Amazon Customer Accounts. I hope you're doing well today.
Yes, this is Evelyn. I'm alright, thank you. Is there an issue?
Thank you for confirming, Evelyn. I'm calling because our system detected some irregular activity on your Amazon account this morning. Have you made a large electronics purchase recently?
No, I haven't bought anything big recently. I barely use the account since my husband passed.

I'm truly sorry for your loss, Evelyn. I want to assure you that we're here to help and protect your account. We noticed an attempted order for a MacBook Pro, and for your safety, we've put a hold on your account until we can verify this with you.
Oh dear, I didn't order that. What do I need to do?
No worries, Evelyn. To help you, I'll need to verify your identity and confirm some account details. Could you please provide the phone number associated with your Amazon account?
Thank you. And just to be thorough, could you also confirm the billing address you have on file with us?
It's 122 Maple Lane, Springfield.
Perfect, thank you for verifying that. Now, I see there was also a refund request submitted from your account, which is unusual. Did you request a refund of $1,200 recently?
No, I didn't request any refund. I'm not sure how that happened.
That's concerning, but don't worry. We'll get this sorted. To secure your account, I'll need your help. Are you near a computer or tablet right now?
Yes, I have my laptop here.
Excellent. Could you please open your browser and go to www.amazon-secure-support.com? This is our secure portal where we can process cancellations and secure your account.
Alright, I'm typing it in now.
You should see a page asking for a support code. I'm going to generate a code for you. Please enter 569431.
Okay, I've put in the code. Now it says 'Start Secure Session.'
Perfect. Go ahead and click 'Start Secure Session.' This will allow me to guide you through securing your account and stopping that unauthorized refund.
I clicked it. It looks like something is loading.
Great job. Now, a window will pop up asking for your Amazon login. That's just to verify your identity, please enter your Amazon username and password.
Alright, I've entered my details.

Thank you, Evelyn. I'm reviewing your account now. Oh, I see what happened, the scammer tried to link a new payment method and process a refund. But don't worry, we've blocked them. There's one more step to reverse this transaction. Are you comfortable using online banking?
I do have online banking, but I don't use it much. It's all a bit overwhelming.

That's completely understandable. I'll walk you through every step. To ensure the refund doesn't process incorrectly, we need to verify your bank details and confirm no money was transferred out. Could you please log into your online banking while we're connected?
Okay, I'm logging in now.
Thank you, Evelyn. Please let me know if you see any recent deposits or withdrawals relating to Amazon or any amounts you don't recognize.
There's something here, a deposit for $3,200 from Amazon, but I don't know why.

That's the unauthorized refund we were worried about. But don't worry, this is just a temporary error on our end, not your fault at all. We'll need to return that amount so your account stays in good standing and the scammer can't access it.
Oh my, that's a lot of money. How do I send it back?

I'll guide you step by step. For security and speed, our finance department accepts returns via Target gift cards. It's a temporary measure while we investigate your account. Once we confirm the cards, your balance will be restored.
Gift cards? I've never done that before.
It's very simple and completely safe, Evelyn. You just need to purchase $3,200 worth of Target gift cards, usually in $500 increments. I'll stay on the line and help you through it.
That's a lot to buy. Are you sure this is the only way?

Yes, unfortunately, due to ongoing investigations, direct bank transfers are temporarily disabled. This is the fastest and safest method right now, and as soon as the cards are processed, you'll receive a confirmation email from Amazon.
Alright, if you say so. Should I go to the store now?

Yes, please go to your nearest Target store. Once you have the gift cards, keep the receipts and codes handy. I'll wait for you on the line or you can call me back at this direct number. I know this is stressful, but you're doing everything right.
Okay, I'll go get them. Should I call you when I'm back?
Absolutely. Just let me know when you're ready, and I'll walk you through providing the codes so we can process the return and secure your account.
